tools.name: OpenHands Agent Canvas
tools.role: Developer control center and execution layer for repo-scoped coding agents and automations.
capabilities: run Codex and other ACP-compatible agents
work against mounted GitHub project workspaces
run local, Docker, VM, or cloud agent backends
support scheduled or event-driven engineering automations
tools.notes: Keep OpenHands separate from customer-facing application code. Use it as a development control plane; GitHub remains source of truth.
